paite: Huchiin huai hun chiangin Mikael, lal thupi na mite tapa adia pangpa, a ding khe ding hi; huan buai hun, nam a om kipan huai hun mah tan hiala leng huchibang om ngei lou, a om ding, huai hun chiangin na mite hutkhiakin a om ding ua, laibu sunga gelha oma amuh khiak ding mi chiteng.
english: “At that time shall Michael stand up, the great prince who stands for the children of your people; and there shall be a time of trouble, such as never was since there was a nation even to that same time: and at that time your people shall be delivered, everyone who shall be found written in the book.

paite: Huan a lak ua mi tampi leia leivuia ihmute a khanglou ding ua, a khen tangtawn hinna tang dingin, a khen zumna leh tangtawna simmohna tang dingin.
english: Many of those who sleep in the dust of the earth shall awake, some to everlasting life, and some to shame and everlasting contempt.

paite: Huan a pilte vansin vakna bangin a tang ding ua; huan mi tampi diktatna lama heite tangtawn tangtawn in akisite bangin.
english: Those who are wise shall shine as the brightness of the expanse; and those who turn many to righteousness as the stars forever and ever.

paite: Himahleh nang, Aw Danial, thute khakkhum bikbek inla, tawp hun tan ading ngeiin, laibu tuh bilhin; mi tampi a vial tai ding ua, theihna a pung ding hi.
english: But you, Daniel, shut up the words, and seal the book, even to the time of the end: many shall run back and forth, and knowledge shall be increased.”

paite: Huailaiin kei Danialin ka ena, huan ngaiin, mi nih dang, khat lui gei hiai lam pangah, huan khat lui gei hua lam pang ah a ding ua.
english: Then I, Daniel, looked, and behold, two others stood, one on the river bank on this side, and the other on the river bank on that side.

paite: Huan khatin puan malngat a silha, lui tuite tunga ompa kiangah, Hiai thillamdangte tawpna ding bangchi sawt ahi ding? a chi a.
english: One said to the man clothed in linen, who was above the waters of the river, How long shall it be to the end of these wonders?

paite: Huan puanmalngat silha, lui tuite tunga dingpan van lama a khut taklam leh a khut veilam zan toua, hun khat, hunte leh hun kimkhat ahi ding chia amah khantawna hingpaa a kichiam ka zataa; huan mi siangthoute thilhihtheihna a suk nen dimdem khit chiang un, hiai thil tengteng zoh ahi ding hi, chiin.
english: I heard the man clothed in linen, who was above the waters of the river, when he held up his right hand and his left hand to heaven, and swore by him who lives forever that it shall be for a time, times, and a half; and when they have made an end of breaking in pieces the power of the holy people, all these things shall be finished.

paite: Huan ka jaa, himahleh ka theisiamn keia; huan ken, Aw ka TOUPA, hiai thilte tawp bang ahi ding? ka chi a.
english: I heard, but I didn’t understand: then I said, my lord, what shall be the issue of these things?

paite: Huan aman, Pai in, Danial: thute lah khakkhum bikbek ahi ua tap hun matana bilh bikbek ahi ngala.
english: He said, Go your way, Daniel; for the words are shut up and sealed until the time of the end.

paite: Mi tampi a kihihsiang ding ua, a kingousak ding ua, a kibawlhoih ding uh; himahleh gilouten giloutakin a hih ding ua; huan giloute laka kuamahin a theisiam kei ding uh; himahleh a pilten a theisiam ding uhi.
english: Many shall purify themselves, and make themselves white, and be refined; but the wicked shall do wickedly; and none of the wicked shall understand; but those who are wise shall understand.

paite: Huchiin halmang thillat gige lak manga oma, hihgawptu kihhuai tun khiaka hong om ding hun akipan, ni sang khat zanih leh sawmkua a om ding hi.
english: From the time that the continual burnt offering shall be taken away, and the abomination that makes desolate set up, there shall be one thousand two hundred ninety days.

paite: Ni sangkhat za thum leh sawmthum leh nga ngaka, huai a hong-a paiten nuam a sa uhi.Himahleh a tawp matan nang jaw pai in; na khawl dinga, nang adia piak na muh ah nite beina ah ding ding na hi ngala.
english: Blessed is he who waits, and comes to the one thousand three hundred thirty-five days.

paite: Himahleh a tawp matan nang jaw pai in; na khawl dinga, nang adia piak na muh ah nite beina ah ding ding na hi ngala.
english: But go you your way until the end; for you shall rest, and shall stand in your lot, at the end of the days.
